campaign.selectedSourceSet: R9-R08 material producer, v2 guard, read-only locked read-set probe, and isolated tests
campaign.prerequisiteState: PDP-0 status is not DEV_COMPLETE for this cut; current application plan remains blocked pending currentness and authentic owner-allocated authority inputs.
campaign.permittedWork: Versioned source-governance tooling review and isolated tests. No canonical source, authority, phase-status, apply, acceptance, or closure mutation.

independentFindings.rootCause: The guard previously hashed entry.bytes while validating a separately supplied entry.value, allowing unrelated bytes to accompany a syntactically valid record object.
independentFindings.repair: The guard now requires exact record keys, parses the hashed JSON bytes, and compares canonical parsed content with the validated record value before accepting its digest-chain link.
independentFindings.independentNegativeTest: A valid but unrelated JSON object with its own matching digest is rejected because parsed bytes differ from the decision value.

independentFindings.rootCause: Caller-provided identity, credential-reference, grant-reference, status, and digest fields were treated as proof of trusted role admission without resolving them from an authenticated registry.
independentFindings.repair: The guard now rejects all actorTrust inputs while the fixed authenticated actor registry is NOT_REGISTERED. This prevents fabricated tokens from producing an admission result.
independentFindings.independentNegativeTest: Four fabricated identities and arbitrary credential/grant digests are rejected. The current Media owner execution authorization states trustedAdmission is NOT_ISSUED.
independentFindings.remainingOwnerAction: Register an authentic fixed actor registry and verifier/root binding through its owner-controlled authority path before enabling positive actor admission. No such Media registry or trust root was present in this source cut.

independentFindings.rootCause: The current R9-R08 entrypoint is a read-only whole-file read-set probe. It invokes only validateR9R08V2ExternalApplyReadSet under the shared lock; its source comment says a future writer must call it. There is no R9-R08 commit writer that reruns semantic pin, profile, parsed-record, and authentic actor checks under the lease before snapshots.
independentFindings.evidence: The probe returns before lock acquisition when the fixed apply-authorization file is absent. The 31-test suite exercises pure fixture validation and that missing-authorization fail-closed branch; it does not prove an authorized under-lease drift rejection before journal, snapshot, or target effects.
independentFindings.requiredFix: Implement a fixed-path R9-R08 writer whose beforePrepare callback reloads and validates the complete profile, exact parsed external records, fixed authenticated actor registry, PXD-225 semantic pin, seven live read preimages, and four target postimages while the shared owner lock is held. Keep decision-log.md read-only.

independentFindings.evidence: PXD-225 Decision/Currentness/Boundary pins remain separate from its Authority subsection. The whole decision-log digest remains a separate final read-set member. The guard fixes seven ordered read paths and four ordered write paths and rejects drift, reordering, substitution, and a decision-log write target.

The current approval-input producer replay now matches generated material/schema artifacts. The application plan replays as BLOCKED_PENDING_AUTHORITY_AND_CURRENTNESS with five explicit blockers; no artifacts were regenerated by this review.
